summary: Corrected the one promoted item whose content no longer matched its receipts. The extended-window fact quoted a single execution's latencies (5509ms for the second confirmation, 20003ms for the control) while now citing three executions whose values are 4928/5398/5509ms and 20002/20003/20007ms, so its statement now reports the observed range and keeps the same subject, conditions, sources and executions; the correction is filed under the entry's own id with changed_premise explaining the difference, and no recorded use depended on the exact milliseconds since the interpretations cite parsed indices rather than latencies. That leaves the run coherent and complete: three settled lines, each with fixed experiments, retained receipts, current interpretations and promoted knowledge (VerifyLeader confirmable by a non-voter's acknowledgement for the whole configured lease with the voter-only lease as the bound, asserted; the demotion-view lag refuted and closed; LeadershipTransferToServer to a non-voter reporting success while the sitting leadership is interrupted and a fresh election decides, asserted), plus one open, owned gap about the unexplained divergence of the near_node_self_voter field, which no claim in the run depends on. Nothing further was submitted, since the remaining allocation is shorter than a construction, execution and interpretation cycle.
